Q: How should a retrieved instruction be prevented from gaining tool authority?
spoken: Treat retrieved text as data under the application’s trust model, even when it contains instructions or claims to be a system message. Apply server-side capability, argument and resource authorization at tool dispatch. Limit outputs and egress where appropriate, and evaluate actual denied effects. Delimiters and an instruction to ignore attacks are useful context controls, not a permission boundary.
